spec.name: sprint47_taker_imbalance_cont_btceth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme taker buy/sell imbalance over the first 5 minutes of a quarter-hour predicts same-direction drift over the next 60 minutes in BTC and ETH, net of fees.
spec.power_argument: Expected validation trades >=300 (2 symbols x cap 6/day x ~25 validation days). Assumed 60m return SD ~35bps (to be re-measured on train before sealing); at n=300, t=3 gives min detectable net edge ~6bps/trade. Unlike sprints 44-46, the trigger frequency is verified on train data to be >0 before the run. If train trigger count implies <300 validation trades, do not run.
